Native model metadata

Opt-in native Claude Desktop model metadata, saved-chat migration, and verified controls.

About 2 min read

On a Claude Desktop version that supports behavesAs in its inference model profile, prepare a candidate with:

gateway claude-desktop configure --gateway-config /absolute/claude-gateway.json \
  --native-model-metadata

This mode keeps the stable opaque claude-hg-route-<decimal> ID for each secondary model and adds behavesAs: "claude-opus-5" to rows that advertise reasoning levels. Claude uses its native client handling for that declared model, including effort controls. The visible label and adapter route still identify the actual provider and account. This does not modify or re-sign Claude.app, enable Fast or Ultracode, or establish the provider's context window. The adapter still bounds the requested effort to the route's advertised levels.

The flag is configure-only and off by default. Older clients retain the existing model-ID mapping unless the operator explicitly opts in. Review the generated candidate before applying with the same flag and --apply, after quitting Claude. Both earlier opaque IDs and the claude-opus-5[hg-route-<decimal>] IDs remain accepted by the adapter for saved chats. Explicit effort caps survive regeneration and migration between the two modes.

On 10 November 2026, unmodified signed Claude Desktop 4.23118.1 passed an isolated synthetic check with native CLI 2.1.299. The opaque reasoning row showed Low, Medium, High, Extra and Max; a second row capped at High omitted Extra and Max. The actual adapter received Max for the first route and Low for the second. After quitting and relaunching the fixture app, its chat, selected model and Low effort survived, and a new turn completed. This used no provider account or paid inference, and does not qualify real-provider cache behavior or long compaction. The CLI control without behavesAs also passed explicit effort flags: the new benefit verified here is the Desktop control, not a different effort transport. See the picker capture and sanitized receipt.

Run the native CLI proof after building:

node scripts/e2e-claude-native-metadata.mjs --claude /absolute/path/to/claude

--serve creates a separate profile library containing only the two fixture models, plus gui-cli and gui-workspace, and keeps the loopback adapter alive for a manual GUI check. Set fixture_root to the actual root printed by the runner, then launch the unmodified signed app:

CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$fixture_root/gui-cli" \
  /Applications/Claude.app/Contents/MacOS/Claude \
  --user-data-dir="$fixture_root/desktop-3p" --use-mock-keychain

Use only these fresh directories. Never use mock encryption with a real profile or account. Choose gui-workspace in the test app before sending a prompt. Stop the fixture after closing its test app; copy its compact receipts before cleaning its task directory.
